entities.name: Sidelink RRC Reconfiguration Procedure
entities.description: Procedure to modify a PC5-RRC connection, including establishment/modification/release of sidelink DRBs, configuration of NR sidelink measurement and reporting, configuration of sidelink CSI reference signal resources and CSI reporting latency bound, and configuration of sidelink DRX.

entities.name: RRCReconfigurationSidelink
entities.description: Message sent to initiate sidelink RRC reconfiguration procedure between UEs over PC5 interface.

entities.name: RRCReconfigurationCompleteSidelink
entities.description: Message sent to indicate successful completion of sidelink RRC reconfiguration procedure.

entities.name: RRCReconfigurationFailureSidelink
entities.description: Message sent to indicate failure of sidelink RRC reconfiguration procedure.

entities.name: RRC_CONNECTED
entities.description: RRC state where UE applies NR sidelink communications parameters provided in RRCReconfiguration message.

entities.name: RRC_IDLE
entities.description: RRC state where UE applies NR sidelink communications parameters provided in system information.

entities.name: RRC_INACTIVE
entities.description: RRC state where UE applies NR sidelink communications parameters provided in system information.

entities.name: NR Sidelink Communications Parameters
entities.description: Configuration parameters for sidelink communication that are applied based on UE RRC state and provided via RRCReconfiguration, system information, or SidelinkPreconfigNR.

entities.name: State Transition Between RRC States
entities.description: Condition when UE transitions between RRC_CONNECTED, RRC_IDLE, and RRC_INACTIVE states, requiring application of new sidelink parameters after acquisition.

relations.description: The sidelink RRC reconfiguration procedure involves sending RRCReconfigurationSidelink message.
Successful completion of the procedure involves sending RRCReconfigurationCompleteSidelink message.
Procedure failure involves sending RRCReconfigurationFailureSidelink message.
In RRC_CONNECTED state, UE applies NR sidelink communications parameters provided in RRCReconfiguration.
In RRC_IDLE state, UE applies NR sidelink communications parameters provided in system information.
In RRC_INACTIVE state, UE applies NR sidelink communications parameters provided in system information.
During state transition, UE applies new sidelink parameters after acquisition while continuing old parameters until new ones are acquired.
